reconcile.note: The Geneva Bible annotators read Hosea's command as a vision or parable rather than an actual marriage, so no real fornication was literally commanded.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues God's order that Hosea take a 'wife of whoredoms' as a command to commit the very adultery the law elsewhere forbids.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: \"Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness
sides.verseText: When Yahweh spoke at the first by Hosea, Yahweh said to Hosea, \"Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery against from Yahweh.\"
